title: TimeOmni-o1: Bidirectionally Coupling Time Series Foundation Models and LLMs for Multimodal Reasoning and Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.12902v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series from real-world systems are often accompanied by text, such as a report on an event that affects them. Two common tasks on these series are understanding, e.g., answering questions about a series, and forecasting its future values. Both tasks require reasoning over the series and the text together. Moreover, understanding outputs text while forecasting outputs a time series, so serving both requires a model that reads and generates both modalities. Large language models (LLMs) read time series as digit tokens and handle long series poorly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast well from large-scale pretraining but typically neither read nor generate text. Time series language models add a time series modality to the LLM but forecast on the LLM side, leaving the TSFM's pretrained forecasting ability unused. translated_title: TimeOmni-o1：时间序列基础模型与大语言模型的双向耦合，用于多模态推理与预测
translated_abstract: 来自现实世界系统的时间序列通常伴随着文本，例如关于影响该系统的事件的报告。针对这些序列的两类常见任务是理解（例如回答关于序列的问题）和预测其未来值。这两类任务都需要对序列和文本进行联合推理。此外，理解任务输出文本，而预测任务输出时间序列，因此要同时服务这两类任务，需要一个能够读取和生成两种模态的模型。大语言模型（LLM）将时间序列作为数字 token 读取，难以处理长序列。时间序列基础模型（TSFM）凭借大规模预训练具有出色的预测能力，但通常既不能读取也不能生成文本。时间序列语言模型虽然为 LLM 增加了时间序列模态，但预测仍在 LLM 侧进行，未能利用 TSFM 预训练的预测能力。我们提出了 TimeOmni-o1，它将预训练的 TSFM 与 LLM 双向耦合。在一个方向上，TSFM……（摘要不完整，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 提出TimeOmni-o1，通过将预训练的时间序列基础模型与大语言模型双向耦合，实现文本与时间序列两种模态的联合读取与生成，从而统一完成多模态理解问答和未来值预测两类任务。
en_tdlr: TimeOmni-o1 bidirectionally couples a pretrained time series foundation model with an LLM, enabling joint reading and generation of both text and time series to unify multimodal understanding and forecasting tasks.
